title: 回転軸付きのパンフレットラック
description: 公共施設のロビーや観光案内所の床に置く、十二ポケットのパンフレット用回転ラック。四方向三段の独立した空ポケットは底・背板・側板と指掛け切欠きを備え、中央軸、上下のベアリング外装、支持アームと重り入り風の円形台座で支えます。印刷物・看板は付属せず、軸受内部、回転アニメーションや荷重・転倒安定性の検証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.576 × 1.639 × 0.576 m、23,844三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A twelve-pocket brochure carousel for public lobbies and visitor-information floors. Four three-tier faces have separate empty receptacles with floors, back and side walls, and finger-access notches. A central mast, visible upper/lower bearing housings, radial supports and weighted-looking circular base complete the assembly. No printed brochures or signboard are supplied; bearing internals, rotation animation, load and tip-stability validation are absent. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.576 × 1.639 × 0.576 m; 23,844 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
